answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The dawn lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the sable is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the summit of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
